why_separate: Actelion reported in Swiss francs; the gold series is the US-dollar history J&J republished from 2016Q1 after acquiring Actelion. Gold holds one currency per series identity, so the launch quarters 2013Q4-2015Q4 are kept beside the USD series rather than joined to it. value_normalized_usd_millions converts each row.
notes: Each quarter is read from the Actelion release that reports it as current, except 2013Q4 (the fourth-quarter 2014 prior-year column). 2014Q2 is nine months 2014 (112) less Q3 (59) and Q1 (15); 2015Q2 is first half 2015 (208) less Q1 (95); both equal the 38 and 113 the half-year 2015 release prints in its quarterly table. 2014Q3 is the original 59, which the 2015 nine-month release restates to 58. The four 2015 quarters sum to 517 against a stated 516, a rounding difference.
